description: Source code for an S3 directory document loader class, implementing data loading from AWS S3 buckets with support for various file types and integration with langchain document loaders.

classes.name: S3_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Implements a document loader that fetches files from an AWS S3 bucket, supports multiple file formats, and processes documents for downstream use.

methods.name: loadMethods.listRegions
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves available AWS regions for the specified model type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the loader, downloads files from S3, saves them temporarily, and loads documents using appropriate loaders based on file extension.
